theorems.name: Submission.variation_areaJacobian_chain_rule
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N N' : ℕ) (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (A : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N') (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), T = LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap → areaJacobian (A.comp L) = areaJacobian (A.comp T.subtypeL) * areaJacobian L
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
